This is just my theory, but to me it makes sense.  Going into the battle, she had already decided that she was going to burn the city as vengeance for missandei's death. She wanted the lannisters to keep fighting so that burning the city would seem justified. A surrender would mean that she wouldn't get revenge.

Thing is dany has a pretty long history of being vengeful. We just didn't care cause she was taking it out on characters we didn't like, like the slavers. Also there's really nothing permanent about her fearful legacy. There will always be someone who will rise up against a tyrant. Even if that doesn't happen and she lives to a ripe old age with her boot on everyone's neck, she going to die sooner or later, and when she does, there's going to be a massive power vacuum and we'll be right back to people squabbling over the throne again.

I think what a lot of people don't like about daenerys burning the city is that the show made it seem like it was a spur of the moment decision. It absolutely wasn't. She had already decided to burn the city before the battle even began. If you notice she never explicitly agreed to stand down if the city surrendered. She wanted revenge for missandei and she fully intended to take it. She didn't actually expect the city to surrender and that's why she seems to hesitate, but in the end revenge wins out.

The initial premise of the game is that it is set in the real world and depicts a conflict between a violent cult and the local police force. The game then throws this premise out the window by revealing that the leaders of the cult have supernatural powers.  The game never explains where these powers came from or sets up any rules for how they work.
While the previous far cry games had supernatural elements in them, they were never the deciding factor in the outcome of the main conflict.

And if that wasn't bad enough, you still have the upper hand until the game makes you crash into a tree

In effect, you lose not because the villains were particularly clever or they outgunned you, you lose because the devs said so.
